name: Educomp Solutions Limited
about: Educomp Solutions Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides education services in India. It operates through Higher Learning Solutions; School Learning Solutions; K-12 Schools; and Online, Supplemental & Global Business segments. The company offers vocational, higher education, and professional development services, as well as smart class and Edureach ICT services; preschools and high schools; and internet based educational and coaching services. It is also involved in the licensing of copyright content and intellectual properties; provision of investment consulting services; sale, supply, and installation of educational products; and leases infrastructure facilities. The company was formerly known as Educomp Datamatics Ltd. and changed its name to Educomp Solutions Limited in August 2005. Educomp Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Gurugram, India.
